signal: pack.abstain_p of the routed lens (each lens's own evidence-coverage signal)
hint_text_if_enabled: If none of the passages states this about me, say that our conversations do not contain it.
notes: Do not tell Reactor to abstain from abstain_p yet. Over dev+dev200 (45 unanswerable vs 606 answerable) no threshold gets above about 0.25 precision: at 0.8 the final routed system has 13 true abstentions against 43 false ones. Lens scales also differ, so on test 6 of 45 ssu packs score 0.8 or more on questions that are probably answerable. One example is 'brand of the grill I last mentioned buying', where Big Green Egg is in the pack. Policy for now: send passages only and let Reactor decide from what they contain. abstain_p is used only for packing choices inside lenses. Re-enable a soft hint (hint_text_if_enabled, never a forced abstention) for a route once its own abstain_p reaches precision >= 0.7 at recall >= 0.4 on dev+dev200 together. The candidates are evidence-based signals: missing event or phrase-bigram coverage for ku and temporal, and the missing-facet check for multi. Lens agents should calibrate abstain_p as a probability on dev+dev200 pooled, since each split alone has too few positives.
